content: The National Standards for Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES), as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasize a comprehensive approach that integrates clinical education, behavioral support, and psychosocial engagement. This multifaceted strategy is designed to holistically support patients in managing their diabetes effectively. With the increasing availability of digital health tools, DSMES programs have expanded their reach through online platforms. This development allows these resources to become accessible to a broader population, particularly benefiting individuals who may have previously encountered barriers related to geography or mobility. To address the challenges posed by the digital divide, DSMES programs have been adapted to ensure equitable access for patients with limited technological resources. These adaptations include implementing strategies to provide digital tools and support to underserved communities, ensuring that all patients can benefit from these educational and supportive services.
